# The compiled binary preserves the renamed grammar and rejects before external calls.
exec zwm --help
cmp stdout help
! stderr .

assert-exit 64 zwm -C
stderr '^zwm: usage: option .-C. requires a value\n$'

assert-exit 64 zwm --project=project wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: usage: unknown global option .--project=project.\n$'

assert-exit 64 zwm co topic
stderr '^zwm: usage: unknown subcommand .co.\n$'

env PATH=$WORK/empty
assert-exit 69 $WORK/bin/zwm -C project wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: preflight: required command .git. is not available\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log
env PATH=$ZWM_TEST_PATH

env ZELLIJ=
assert-exit 69 zwm -C project wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: preflight: must be run inside an existing Zellij session\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log

-- help --
Usage:
  zwm --help | -h
  zwm [-C <name-or-path> | --project <name-or-path>] {wco|pr}
  zwm o <name-or-path>

Commands:
  wco <branch> | wco -b <new-branch> [<start-point>]
  o <name-or-path>
  pr <number|url|branch>

Global options:
  -C <name-or-path>          Select a project before the subcommand.
  --project <name-or-path>   Select a project before the subcommand.
-- empty-log --
